tasks.prompt: Read go.mod, then create benchmark-output/module.txt containing exactly two lines: module=github.com/snow-core/snow and go=1.27, followed by one final newline. Do not modify any other files.

Create benchmark-output/slugify.py using only the Python standard library. It must read one command-line argument and print a lowercase slug: trim whitespace, replace each run of characters other than ASCII letters or digits with one hyphen, and strip leading and trailing hyphens. Do not modify any other files.
verify: import subprocess; p='benchmark-output/slugify.py'; cases=[(' Hello, Snow! ', 'hello-snow'), ('A/B_test v2', 'a-b-test-v2'), ('---', '')]; assert all(subprocess.check_output(['python3', p, value], text=True).strip() == expected for value, expected in cases)

tasks.prompt: Create benchmark-output/fibonacci.py using only the Python standard library. Define fib(n) for nonnegative integers using fib(0)=0 and fib(1)=1, and when run with one integer argument print fib(n). Do not modify any other files.
verify: import importlib.util, subprocess; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fib','benchmark-output/fibonacci.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); assert [m.fib(i) for i in range(8)] == [0,1,1,2,3,5,8,13]; assert subprocess.check_output(['python3','benchmark-output/fibonacci.py','10'], text=True).strip() == '55'

tasks.prompt: Create benchmark-output/test_math.py as a self-contained Python unittest module. Define add(a,b) and is_even(n), and include tests covering positive and negative addition plus even and odd integers. Do not modify any other files.

Create benchmark-output/wordcount.go as a standalone Go program. It must count whitespace-separated words across all command-line arguments and print the count followed by a newline. Use only the Go standard library and do not modify any other files.

Create benchmark-output/line_stats.py using only the Python standard library. Read all text from stdin and print one JSON object with integer keys lines, words, and chars: count newline-delimited lines, whitespace-separated words, and all characters including newlines. Empty input has zero for all three. Do not modify any other files.
verify: import json, subprocess; out=subprocess.check_output(['python3','benchmark-output/line_stats.py'], input='alpha beta\ngamma\n', text=True); assert json.loads(out) == {'lines': 2, 'words': 3, 'chars': 17}

tasks.prompt: Create benchmark-output/search.py using only the Python standard library. Define binary_search(values, target) for an ascending list; return the matching zero-based index or -1 when absent. Do not modify any other files.
verify: import importlib.util; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('search','benchmark-output/search.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); assert m.binary_search([1,3,4,7,9],7) == 3; assert m.binary_search([1,3,4,7,9],5) == -1

tasks.prompt: Create benchmark-output/filter_events.py using only the Python standard library. It must accept a JSONL file path as its only argument, read objects in order, and print a compact JSON array containing the id of every object whose level equals error. Do not modify any other files.

Create benchmark-output/csv_summary.py using only the Python standard library. It must accept a CSV file path with headers item,quantity,price and print compact JSON with integer rows and numeric total equal to the sum of quantity times price. Do not modify any other files.
verify:
import json, subprocess; from pathlib import Path; q=Path('benchmark-input.csv'); q.write_text('item,quantity,price
pen,2,1.50
book,3,4.00
'); out=subprocess.check_output(['python3','benchmark-output/csv_summary.py',str(q)], text=True); got=json.loads(out); assert got['rows'] == 2 and abs(got['total'] - 15.0) < 1e-9
